Front: How do you open a formal introduction with your name?
Back: 안녕하세요, 저는 제임스입니다. / Annyeonghaseyo, jeoneun Jeimseu-imnida. / Hello, I'm James.

Front: How do you say “I studied marketing” formally?
Back: 마케팅을 공부했습니다. / Maketingeul gongbuhaesseumnida. / I studied marketing.

Front: How do you say “I'm learning Korean” in formal register?
Back: 한국어를 배우고 있습니다. / Hangugeoreul baeugo itseumnida. / I'm learning Korean.

Front: How do you express strong interest in a field?
Back: 이 분야에 관심이 많습니다. / I bunyae gwansimi manseumnida. / I'm very interested in this field.

Front: How do you close a formal introduction politely?
Back: 잘 부탁드립니다. / Jal butakdeurimnida. / Thank you in advance.
